description: Defines the json_formatter class for formatting log entries into JSON, including scope management and formatting methods.

classes.name: json_formatter
classes.description: A stateless JSON formatter for log entries, managing scope and nesting levels.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of the formatter.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats a log entry into JSON.

methods.name: format_metric_set_begin
methods.description: Begins a metric set in JSON.

methods.name: format_metric_set_end
methods.description: Ends a metric set in JSON.

methods.name: push_scope
methods.description: Pushes a new scope onto the scope stack.

methods.name: push_list_scope
methods.description: Pushes a new list scope onto the scope stack.

methods.name: pop_scope
methods.description: Pops the top scope from the scope stack.

methods.name: consume_element
methods.description: Consumes an element in the current scope.

methods.name: needs_comma
methods.description: Determines if a comma is needed in current scope.

methods.name: in_list_scope
methods.description: Checks if current scope is a list.

methods.name: indents
methods.description: Calculates indentation spaces based on level.
